data_source.limitations: RETROSPECTIVE RESEARCH ONLY: current government snapshot, not verified historical vintages. Feature-view availability assumes next-day 00:00 Asia/Kolkata publication. Later source revisions may be present. Metrics are conditional on this assumption, not demonstrated live/as-of performance or farmer realized-price accuracy. Artifacts cannot be deployed as validated production forecasts. This extension has NO new final test. Selection validation scores are not final accuracy.

copra_30d_prediction.disclaimer: Empirical uncertainty for mandi modal wholesale prices only. Coverage is not guaranteed. This does not capture individual farmer grade, quality, sorting, fees, transport, bargaining or transaction-price uncertainty, and is not a guaranteed realized selling price or advice to hold produce.
